name: Boiler Upgrade Scheme
eligibility: England or Wales; eligible replacement heating and installation. Oil/LPG uplift requires an eligible off-gas-grid property. Confirm with an MCS installer.

name: Halifax Green Living Reward · check current terms
eligibility: Eligible Halifax mortgage customer and qualifying improvement; one reward only. Confirm current terms and compatibility.

name: Flood Re Build Back Better
eligibility: Only after a flood claim, through a participating insurer, as part of approved repairs. Not upfront funding.

name: Property flood resilience grants
eligibility: Sometimes available after named floods; ask your council. Cannot assume compatibility with insurer funding.
